hed: Armed man arrested after pushing toward Ohio gov candidate Amy Acton at Canfield Fair
dek: Patrick Havas, 38, of Canfield was arrested Sunday inside a Democratic Party tent at the Canfield Fair after pushing through a crowd while gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton was speaking, according to the Mahoning County Sheriff’s Office and Ohio State Highway Patrol. Two people were knocked down; Acton was not injured. Deputies recovered two handguns and brass knuckles; investigators said no weapons were brandished or removed from holsters. Havas was booked on assault and disorderly conduct counts. Gov. Mike DeWine called violence or its threat at political events unacceptable.

cl.body: PBS NewsHour/AP and ABC6 emphasize an armed man charging through a crowd toward Acton, injuries to bystanders, and Highway Patrol troopers on her protective detail making the stop.

cr.body: Sheriff and local desks stress that weapons were recovered but never brandished, Havas was filming as he entered, and the case remains under investigation with assault and disorderly counts filed.
